## Research Profile

Postdoctoral Research Scholar in semiconductor systems, telemetry analytics, and AI-driven system optimization. My work develops deployable, explainable, and low-overhead AI frameworks that use chip-, host-, and facility-level telemetry to improve reliability, energy efficiency, security monitoring, and operational resilience in semiconductor manufacturing facilities and computing platforms.

## Proposed Endeavor

Advance scalable telemetry-driven Silicon Lifecycle Management and semiconductor facility intelligence through causal/explainable AI, digital twins, fixed-point edge analytics, and guardrailed decision support for dependable and energy-efficient operations.
